summary: Nora can put herself in a picture: an image-generation skill tells her when she is in the image and what she looks like, and her canonical self picture works as a reference in any room.
details: A new on-demand image-generation skill leads with one judgement, whether she herself appears in the picture asked for; only then does she attach her canonical self picture.
The skill carries her full visual identity (the mascot form, its proportions and eight anchors) and asks which photo is meant when more than one could be the subject.
Her canonical self picture resolves as an image reference in any conversation; every other reference still has to be a photo already sent in that conversation.
A reference given as a web link or data URI is now refused outright instead of being read as a photo code.
limitations: The canonical picture must be ingested once on the deployment with scripts/ingest_self_asset.py after the image is rebuilt; until then her own reference resolves to nothing.
The skill is loaded on demand: a turn that makes an image without loading it draws without her canonical look.
Reference images stay off unless [image_gen] allow_reference_images is enabled; with it off she describes herself in words instead.
